name: Suita Momiji
source:
Weakness: Anywhere from the neck up (especially her ears).

[url=/c42932]Tsukushi's[/url] classmate and a girl with little presence. When at school, her eyes are always hidden behind her bangs and she pays attention to no one.
Lives alone with her serious minded older sister [url=/c42875]Kaede[/url], she is always being nagged by her, leading to a lot of pent up anger.

Kaede has been returning home late recently, so Momiji goes out downtown at night and happened upon make up, becoming like a different person.

"...Not really. You have nothing to do with this."
